name: shape-2026-09-26
fit: move/shape time model (research/2026-09-26_shape): stage-1 move costs fitted on 5,868 clean chunks of drawn routes between reliably timed planned clicks over 12 vaults; stage-2 per miner: seconds = moveScale x moves + roomEntryS + roomExitS, fitted on whole plan epochs. Runs scale with (vRef / movement speed)^speedElasticity. Clearance is the planner's own (grid clearanceFlyAt). LOVO room R2 chain 0.62 / vein 0.72; chart-style cpm error with coverage 2.1 % / 2.1 %. benchKa/benchKb (player calibration, research/2026-09-28_player_calib): the benchmark player's real over own-trail-priced room seconds = a + b ln(clumpiness), 603 rooms.
